title.zh-CN: 化学平衡、动力学与过程调控实验室
title.en: Chemical Equilibrium, Kinetics, and Process Control Lab

text.zh-CN: 计算并比较 Q 与 K，判断反应净进行方向。
text.en: Calculate and compare Q with K to determine the net reaction direction.

text.zh-CN: 用正逆反应速率和微观粒子变化区分平衡建立速度与平衡位置。
text.en: Use forward and reverse rates and particle-level changes to distinguish equilibration speed from equilibrium position.

text.zh-CN: 综合温度、浓度、压强与催化剂对速率、产率、能耗和安全的影响进行过程调控。
text.en: Balance temperature, concentration, pressure, and catalyst effects on rate, yield, energy, and safety.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 可逆反应、化学计量关系和浓度表示。
碰撞理论、活化能和反应速率。
prerequisites.en: Collision theory, activation energy, and reaction rate.

text.zh-CN: 认为达到平衡后正逆反应停止或各物质浓度相等。
text.en: Believing forward and reverse reactions stop, or all concentrations become equal, at equilibrium.

text.zh-CN: 认为催化剂会改变平衡常数或最终平衡组成。
text.en: Believing a catalyst changes the equilibrium constant or final equilibrium composition.

text.zh-CN: 认为提高反应速率的条件一定同时提高平衡产率。
text.en: Assuming conditions that increase rate must also increase equilibrium yield.

invariants.zh-CN: 物料守恒和给定反应的化学计量关系在每一步都成立。
invariants.en: Mass conservation and reaction stoichiometry hold at every step.

invariants.zh-CN: 同一温度下催化剂可同时改变正逆反应速率，但不改变 K 和平衡组成。
invariants.en: At a fixed temperature, a catalyst may change both rates but not K or equilibrium composition.

title.zh-CN: Q 与 K：反应往哪里走
title.en: Q and K: Which Way Will It Go?

title.zh-CN: 速率、产率与代价的权衡
title.en: Trade Off Rate, Yield, and Cost

prompt.zh-CN: 改变初始组成后先比较 Q 与 K，再预测净反应方向。
prompt.en: After changing initial composition, compare Q with K and predict the net reaction direction.

successEvidence.zh-CN: Q、K 计算及方向判断一致。
successEvidence.en: The Q and K calculation supports the stated direction.

prompt.zh-CN: 用有无催化剂的两次实验说明速率与平衡位置的区别。
prompt.en: Compare trials with and without a catalyst to distinguish rate from equilibrium position.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 证据显示到达平衡所需时间改变，但同温度下 K 与最终组成不变。
successEvidence.en: Evidence shows equilibration time changes while K and final composition remain unchanged at the same temperature.

prompt.zh-CN: 在产率、时间、能耗和风险约束下选择工艺条件并解释权衡。
prompt.en: Choose process conditions under yield, time, energy, and risk constraints and justify the tradeoff.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 方案引用模拟数据，并区分动力学影响和平衡影响。
successEvidence.en: The plan cites simulated data and distinguishes kinetic from equilibrium effects.

steps: 用键盘改变组成并完成 Q 与 K 方向预测。
对比有无催化剂的速率曲线和平衡终态。
在多目标约束下选择工艺条件并提交解释。
在两个外部测试站点中重复核心流程。
Change composition with the keyboard and predict direction from Q and K.
Compare rate curves and final equilibrium states with and without a catalyst.
Choose process conditions under multiple constraints and submit an explanation.
Repeat the core flow in two external test hosts.

accessibility.zh-CN: 粒子动画同步提供浓度、速率和文字状态，不依赖动画本身传达结论。
accessibility.en: Particle animation is paired with concentrations, rates, and text states so meaning does not depend on motion.

accessibility.zh-CN: 图线使用标签、线型和数据表区分，不只依赖颜色。
accessibility.en: Curves use labels, line styles, and a data table rather than color alone.
